subject.title: [Bug]: restart storm from telegram.retry.jitter type mismatch + misleading doctor SecretRef for Telegram token

question: After the linked jitter-migration PR is resolved, should this umbrella keep tracking the SecretRef and CDP/service-isolation leftovers, or should those be split into narrower issues?
rationale: The central crash-loop branch is already paired with an open PR, while the remaining branches cross SecretRef diagnostics, service supervision, browser/CDP profile isolation, and multi-runtime guidance; automation should not choose that product scope unilaterally.

options.title: Land jitter, then split leftovers
options.body: Keep this issue open until the linked jitter PR is resolved, then create or identify narrower SecretRef and CDP/service issues before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for all remaining restart-storm and diagnostic branches, accepting broader manual coordination.

options.title: Close after jitter lands
options.body: Close once the boolean jitter migration lands if maintainers judge the current SecretRef and service docs/checks sufficient.

recommendation.title: Land jitter, then split leftovers
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the linked jitter PR is resolved, then create or identify narrower SecretRef and CDP/service issues before closing this umbrella.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans retry config, doctor migration ownership, and gateway service policy, where the history points most strongly to steipete.
